messages.subject: Sourcing required app restart
parts: Hi - I'm attempting to split my shiny app out into features (modules/components) - however when i source a file from global.R, server.R or ui.R I need to close & restart the app to see any changes - ie. a browser/window reload, and the reload app button in RStudio do nothing - am I missing something obvious here?
